messages:
julie: quick sync — postmortem follow-up for acme on‑prem incident. root cause recap: intermittent vpc peering flaps + isolation bug in our tenant-ns cleanup. we promised concrete owners/timelines.

devon: i can own the vpc peering remediation (runbook + infra guardrails). will draft runbook and a preflight checklist. target: draft by 2026-04-08.

ankur: i'll take the isolation bug (edge-case in namespace GC + race when sockets close). plan: patch + unit tests + canary on dedicated. aiming for patch by Fri (2026-04-05).

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-042 — referenced action items added to tracker.

maria: forwarding to acme CSM — they asked for ETA and mitigation until fix is live. suggest we provide a temporary routing policy to avoid affected AZs.

ben: recurring pattern note — this is the 3rd time peering + cleanup race showed up across customers. we should schedule a short cross-team retro to identify systemic mitigations (tools, tests, alerts).

julie: agreed. propose this immediate action list: (copy these into the tracker + assign)

```
- A1: Peering runbook + preflight checks — owner: devon — due: 2026-04-08 — success criteria: playbook + automated preflight ci job
- A2: Isolation bug patch + canary — owner: ankur — due: 2026-04-05 — success criteria: regression tests + canary 2k reqs without repro
- A3: Temporary routing policy for acme — owner: maria (coord with devon) — due: 2026-04-03 — success criteria: customer confirmation and reduced error rate
- A4: Add synthetic for peering flaps to CI / alerting — owner: ben — due: 2026-04-15 — success criteria: alert fires in staging and runbook link in alert
- A5: 2-week recurring "isolation trends" review — owner: julie — cadence: biweekly starting 2026-04-12
```

devon: will add the preflight job as a terraform validate + smoke test in our infra repo. ping me if you need a rollback plan.

ankur: note — the GC race is triggered by delayed tcp-close events on older on‑prem boxes. i'll include a mitigation that adds a short backoff before namespace reclaim. will doc the compatibility caveat.

maria: i'll get acme the temporary routing plan today and ask for acceptance windows.

ben: scheduling note — i'll carve 30m in the eng‑sre calendar for the first trends review and invite eng-platform, eng-runtime, and customer success.

julie: nice. devon/ankur/maria/ben — please update the tracker rows with links to PRs or docs when available. i'll follow up on 2026-04-09 to verify progress. :calendar: :thumbsup:
